'''Kosimo Westermal''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] and member of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] who was on [[Nickel One]] when [[Darth Caedus]] approached the Moff Council about an alliance with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. After the attack by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Second Battle of Roche]], Westermal showed some concern for Caedus after Caedus planned to deal with the sniper who had shot him in the shoulder.
